about: Torch braze station: a 48 x 30 in welding table (3/8 in hot-rolled plate on a 1.5 in angle frame, 2 in angle-iron legs on foot plates, a lower shelf), a hearth of six 9 x 4 x 2.5 in firebricks in a steel tray with a back wall where carbide-tipped tool shanks are brazed, an oxy-acetylene torch on the plate, its twin red/green hose run over the table's end, looped on the floor and up to two-gauge regulators, and the cylinders strapped to the table frame: acetylene (10 in, maroon) and oxygen (7 in, green), valves, handwheels and shoulder labels. A flux pot, silver braze rod, a striker and a galvanised quench pail. Self-made in Blender (sources/braze/build_braze.py) where the placeholder (planner.placeholders.braze_station) has its boxes.
reviewed: 2026-11-05: modelled; look sheets and three.js before/after checked

source.made: self-made in Blender from public dimensions and photos; build script and .blend beside it

sources_used: the record's key specs (48 x 30 in steel bench, oxygen and acetylene cylinders, silver braze with flux) and its placeholder for every part's position
